sth_verger.text: There's been a church here for about a thousand years, and some of the stones are older than the building. The church is called the Town Church, as if there were competition.
Jersey has twelve parishes, each with its own church, its own elected Connétable and its own Honorary Police. They take it very seriously and always have.

then.text: The ropes are yours any time. The band is always short of a treble.
Quayle sent you? Good. The Roll's Channel Islands section wants ringing out, and I am a ringer short. Take a rope.
That was in time. Liberation Day is the ninth of May, a public holiday on the island, and the bells will be ready. Tell Miss Quayle the Channel Islands' part of the Roll will be rung.

else.text: Not rung through yet. Another go. Listen first, pull second.
Six bells, six ringers, one very patient vicar. Come back when you've an hour.
